_status: PRE-DECLARED BEFORE THE REMAINING UNITS ARE EXTRACTED (operator instruction, 2026-08-11). Frozen into PREREGISTRATION.md verbatim.
_why_predeclared: Choosing redaction-bias pairs AFTER seeing which units came out thin selects the control on the outcome it measures. The pairing is therefore fixed by a mechanical rule, applied now, to directories and units whose content is in some cases not yet extracted.
_role: Control (c). Each pair is coded BOTH redacted and unredacted, k=3 each, QUARANTINED from all matrices and EXEMPT from H2's leak rule (an unredacted unit necessarily contains source vocabulary — that is the point). Report delta('other' rate) = the redaction floor.

direction_i.rule: Top by banned-term (direction-i lexicon) count in the unit's SOURCE rows — its catalog row plus its dataset row in the two md5-pinned files — computed mechanically, ties broken by unit id ascending. STRATIFIED: 2 from the agreeing stratum + 1 from the disagreeing stratum.
direction_i.why_stratified: The unstratified top 3 all fall in the agreeing stratum (13/7/6 hits, all agreeing). Since the amendment gives the two strata DIFFERENT verdict grammars, a redaction floor measured only on single-class units would not transfer to the multi-membership stratum where a two-pattern split is the expected result. The stratification was chosen because of that structural asymmetry, before any coding.
direction_i.selection_note: movespeed_tcc_sandbox is also the row that disagrees with itself (dataset assigns A while that row's own paper_class_ref cites E and only E). It was NOT selected for that reason — it is the top-density disagreeing unit under the mechanical rule, tied at 4 hits with v37_9_92_observer_path_blood and taken by the pre-declared id-ascending tiebreak. Recorded because a reader would otherwise reasonably suspect selection on interestingness.

direction_ii.rule: Top 3 sampled directories by pattern-vocabulary hit count in their source prose, EXCLUDING the 4 overlap directories, ties broken by earliest directory date.
direction_ii.why_exclude_overlap: Overlap dirs already carry a different quarantined role (the extraction-churn floor). Using one for both would tangle the accounting of two independent controls and make a flip in either unreadable.
direction_ii.excluded_by_rule: 2025-05-15_recon_2 (7 hits) is the second-densest sampled dir but is an OVERLAP dir, excluded per the rule above. 2026-06-11_oq97_pattern6_census ties at 4 hits with stakeholder_layer_migration and loses the earliest-date tiebreak (2026-06-11 vs 2026-06-07).
direction_ii.note: None of the three is extracted yet. That is deliberate: the declaration binds before the content exists, which is the strongest available form of pre-registration for this control.

reproduction: python3 python/audits/oq277_lexicon.py provides the matcher; direction-(i) counts are over each unit's catalog row + dataset row in packets/wu_source/ (md5s in FETCH_MANIFEST.txt); direction-(ii) counts are over all *.md in each sampled directory.
